title: High Protein Pasta
reject_reason: Creamy cottage-cheese-and-parmesan sauce with sun-dried tomatoes, spinach and basil over chicken pasta is the Tuscan/Marry-Me creamy sun-dried-tomato chicken pasta identity, same dinner as live slow-cooker-tuscan-chicken-pasta; the cottage-cheese high-protein twist is a technique, not a new plate, and the chicken-cream-pasta lane is already dense (butter-chicken-pasta and pesto pasta accepted this run).
